subject: english

units.name: 第4单元 The Wonders of Nature

topics.name: 不定式表示目的
topics.description: 能用 to 加动词原形说明做某事的目的。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 我去公园是为了做志愿者。哪一句正确？
example.answer: I went to the park to volunteer.

topics.name: 身体不适
topics.description: 认读 headache、stomachache、fever 和 cough。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「头痛」？

topics.name: should 表示建议
topics.description: 能用 should 或 shouldn't 提出建议。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 你应该去看医生。哪一句正确？

topics.name: 反身代词
topics.description: 用 myself、yourself、himself、herself 等表示「自己」。
mastery_criteria: 能在选择题中选出正确的一项
能在新版教材单元语境中运用

example.question: She cut ____ when she was cooking.

topics.name: 关心身体
topics.description: 能询问别人怎么了，并给出简单建议。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 看到同学不舒服，哪一句合适？

topics.name: 读健康建议
topics.description: 读一段对话，找出症状和建议。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和短文意思一致的句子

example.question: Ben has a stomachache. The doctor says he should not eat cold food. 他怎么了？

topics.name: 情绪与压力
topics.description: 认读 pressure、argue、nervous 和 proper。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「压力」？

topics.name: although 引导让步
topics.description: 能用 although 连接相反的两层意思，并且不和 but 同时使用。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 虽然他很累，但是他做完了作业。哪一句正确？
example.answer: Although he was tired, he finished his homework.

topics.name: so that 表示目的
topics.description: 能用 so that 说明目的，从句里常用 can 或 could。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 他早起是为了赶上公共汽车。哪一句正确？
example.answer: He got up early so that he could catch the bus.

topics.name: 用 Why don't you 提建议
topics.description: 能用 Why don't you 或 Why not 建议别人怎么做。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 建议对方和父母谈谈，哪一句合适？
example.answer: Why don't you talk to your parents?

topics.name: 读建议信
topics.description: 读一封短信，找出问题和建议。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和短文意思一致的句子

example.question: Dear Linda, I argued with my parents. I feel nervous. What should I do? 写信人怎么了？
example.answer: 和父母吵了架，感到紧张

topics.name: 地理名称
topics.unit_name: 第4单元 The Wonders of Nature
topics.description: 认读 desert、ocean、ancient 和 protect。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「沙漠」？

topics.name: 比较级与最高级的选用
topics.unit_name: 第4单元 The Wonders of Nature
topics.description: 能根据是两者还是三者以上，选用比较级或最高级。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山。哪一句正确？
example.answer: Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.

topics.name: 陈述地理事实
topics.unit_name: 第4单元 The Wonders of Nature
topics.description: 能用事实句说出地理事物有多大、多高。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想说这片沙漠很大，哪一句合适？

topics.name: 读地理短文
topics.unit_name: 第4单元 The Wonders of Nature
topics.description: 读一段地理短文，找出最高或最长的事物。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和短文意思一致的句子

example.question: Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world. It is higher than any other mountain. 它是什么？

topics.name: 选词补全短文
topics.description: 能根据上下文选择意思和语法都通顺的词。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和短文意思一致的句子

example.question: Tom ___ to the library yesterday. He read an old book about the ocean. 横线处选哪一个？

topics.name: 暴风雨
topics.description: 认读 rainstorm、alarm、flashlight 和 wind。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「暴风雨」？

topics.name: 过去进行时
topics.description: 能用 was 或 were 加动词的 -ing 形式，描述过去某时正在做的事。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 昨晚八点我正在读书。哪一句正确？
example.answer: I was reading at eight last night.

topics.name: when 与 while
topics.description: 能用 when 连接一个短暂动作，用 while 连接一段正在进行的动作。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 暴风雨来的时候，我正在读。哪一句正确？
example.answer: I was reading when the rainstorm came.

topics.name: 描述当时的动作
topics.description: 能询问过去某一时刻正在做什么。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想问暴风雨来时对方在做什么，哪一句合适？
example.answer: What were you doing when the rainstorm came?

topics.name: 读暴风雨故事
topics.description: 读一段故事，找出暴风雨来时人们正在做什么。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和短文意思一致的句子

example.question: When the rainstorm came, Ben was reading. His sister was sleeping. 暴风雨来时 Ben 在做什么？

topics.name: 社交习俗
topics.description: 认读 bow、kiss、greet 和 manner。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「鞠躬」？

topics.name: unless 表示除非
topics.description: 能用 unless 表示如果不，从句用一般现在时。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 除非你赶快，否则会迟到。哪一句正确？
example.answer: You will be late unless you hurry.

topics.name: be supposed to
topics.description: 能用 be supposed to 表示按习俗或规则应该做的事。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 你应该握手。哪一句正确？
example.answer: You are supposed to shake hands.

topics.name: 说明该怎么做
topics.description: 能介绍一个地方见面时该怎么打招呼。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 在中国，朋友见面常常握手。哪一句合适？
example.answer: In China, people are supposed to shake hands.

topics.name: 读习俗说明
topics.description: 读一段习俗说明，找出该做和不该做的事。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和短文意思一致的句子

example.question: In this country, you are supposed to bow when you meet someone. You are not supposed to kiss. 见面应该做什么？

topics.name: 书籍与阅读
topics.description: 认读 treasure、island、classic 和 page。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「宝藏」？

topics.name: 现在完成时
topics.description: 能用 have 或 has 加过去分词，表示到现在为止已经发生的事。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 我已经读完了这本书。哪一句正确？
example.answer: I have already read this book.

topics.name: already 与 yet
topics.description: 能在肯定句中用 already，在疑问句和否定句中用 yet。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 我已经做完作业了。哪一句正确？
example.answer: I have already finished my homework.

topics.name: 谈论读过的书
topics.description: 能询问别人是否已经读过某本书。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想问对方是否已经读过这本名著，哪一句合适？
example.answer: Have you read this classic yet?

topics.name: 读阅读记录
topics.description: 读一段阅读记录，判断谁已经读完。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和短文意思一致的句子

example.question: Amy has already read Treasure Island. Pete has not finished it yet. 谁已经读完了？

topics.name: 场馆经历
topics.description: 认读 camera、progress、unusual 和 collect。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「照相机」？

topics.name: ever 与 never
topics.description: 能用 ever 询问是否曾经做过，用 never 表示从未做过。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 你曾经去过博物馆吗？哪一句正确？
example.answer: Have you ever been to a museum?

topics.name: been 与 gone
topics.description: 能区分 has been to（去过并已回来）和 has gone to（去了尚未回来）。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 她现在不在这里，去了图书馆。哪一句正确？
example.answer: She has gone to the library.

topics.name: 询问去过哪里
topics.description: 能询问别人的经历，并说出自己去过哪里。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想问对方是否去过游乐园，哪一句合适？
example.answer: Have you ever been to an amusement park?

topics.name: 读场馆经历
topics.description: 读一段经历，区分去过和正在那里。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和短文意思一致的句子

example.question: Kate has been to the science museum. She took photos there last month. 她现在还在馆里吗？

topics.name: 志愿服务
topics.description: 认读 volunteer、lonely、sign 和 notice。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「志愿者」？

topics.name: 主动提供帮助
topics.description: 能提出帮忙，并说明能做什么。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想说自己可以发食物，哪一句合适？

topics.name: 读志愿活动
topics.description: 读一则通知，找出时间和需要做的事。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和短文意思一致的句子

example.question: We need volunteers to clean up the city park on Saturday. Please call Mr. Li. 需要志愿者做什么？

topics.name: 旧物与回忆
topics.description: 认读 scarf、soft、yard 和 honest。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「围巾」？

topics.name: for 与 since
topics.description: 能用 for 加一段时间，用 since 加过去的起点。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能在句子里用对这个句型

example.question: 这辆自行车我买了三年了。哪一句正确？
example.answer: I have had this bike for three years.

topics.name: 谈论拥有多久
topics.description: 能询问一件物品拥有了多久，并回答。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想问对方拥有这条围巾多久了，哪一句合适？
example.answer: How long have you had this scarf?

topics.name: 读旧物故事
topics.description: 读一段回忆，找出拥有的时间和原因。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和短文意思一致的句子

example.question: I have had this scarf for three years. My grandma made it. 围巾是谁做的？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你应该去看医生。哪一句正确？

options: You shouldn't to eat so much.
You don't should eat so much.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 她牙痛，哪一条建议合适？
options: She should to see a dentist.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: should 在这些句子里表示什么？
questions.explain: should 用来告诉别人宜做什么。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 看到同学不舒服，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: What's the matter 用来问出了什么问题。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你头痛，应怎么说？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 对方发烧了，你建议他躺下。哪一句合适？
options: You should lies down and rest.
You should to lie down and rest.
You should lying down and rest.
You should lie down and rest.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 对方说 I have a cough. 你还想问持续多久，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: How long 问持续了多久。
options: How long have you had it?
How long did you had it tomorrow?
How far have you had it?
How often you have it yesterday now?

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Ben has a stomachache. The doctor says he should not eat cold food. 他怎么了？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Ben has a stomachache. The doctor says he should not eat cold food. 医生建议他怎样？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Lisa has a fever and a cough. She should drink more water. 她应该做什么？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Lisa has a fever and a cough. 哪一句和短文一致？
questions.explain: fever and a cough 都有。
options: Lisa has both a fever and a cough.
Ben has a fever in this sentence.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「志愿者」？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 「lonely」的中文意思是哪一个？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 选择表示「标牌」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示标牌的单词是 sign。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「通知」？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 我去公园是为了做志愿者。哪一句正确？
options: I went to the park to volunteer.
I went to the park for volunteer.
I went to the park volunteering.
I went to the park to volunteering.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 她张贴通知是为了找帮手。哪一句正确？
options: She put up a notice find helpers.
She put up a notice to find helpers.
She put up a notice to found helpers.
She put up a notice for find helpers.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: to do 放在句子后部，这里表示什么？
questions.explain: 不定式可以说明为什么做这件事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 他们筹款是为了帮助穷人。哪一句正确？
options: They raise money help the poor.
They raise money to helping the poor.
They raise money for to help the poor.
They raise money to help the poor.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想说自己可以发食物，哪一句合适？
options: I could to give out food.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想问对方想参加志愿活动吗，哪一句合适？
options: Would you like helping out yesterday?
Do you would like to help?

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 孤独的老人需要什么，哪一句说得清楚？
options: They need someone to talking to.
They need someone to talk to.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I'll help to clean up the park. 这句是在做什么？
questions.explain: I'll help to 表示愿意帮忙。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We need volunteers to clean up the city park on Saturday. Please call Mr. Li. 需要志愿者做什么？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We need volunteers to clean up the city park on Saturday. 在星期几？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Anna wants to help. She will give out notices after school. 她放学后做什么？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Anna wants to help. She will give out notices after school. 哪一句和短文一致？
options: Anna will hand out notices after school.
The park clean-up is on Monday.
Mr. Li will give out food at the hospital.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「压力」？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 「argue」的中文意思是哪一个？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 选择表示「紧张的」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示紧张的的单词是 nervous。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「合适的」？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 虽然他很累，但是他做完了作业。哪一句正确？
questions.explain: although 和 but 不同时用。
options: Although he was tired, he finished his homework.
Although he was tired, but he finished his homework.
Although he was tired, so he finished his homework.
Although he is tired, he finished his homework yesterday without a tense.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 虽然她紧张，她还是上了台。哪一句正确？
questions.explain: Although 后面直接接结果，不加 but。
options: Although she was nervous, but she went on the stage.
Although she was nervous, she went on the stage.
Although she nervous, she went on the stage.
Although she was nervous, she goes on the stage yesterday.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: although 的意思接近哪一个？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句使用正确？
options: Although they argue, but they still love each other.
Although they argue, so they still love each other.
But although they argue, they still love.
Although they argue, they still love each other.

questions.subject: english
questions.unit_name: 用 Why don't you 提建议
questions.stem: 建议对方和父母谈谈，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: Why don't you 后面用动词原形。
options: Why don't you to talk to your parents?
Why don't you talk to your parents?
Why not you talk to your parents?
Why don't you talking to your parents?

questions.subject: english
questions.unit_name: 用 Why don't you 提建议
questions.stem: Why not write him a letter? 这句是在做什么？
questions.explain: Why not 加动词原形，用来提建议。

questions.subject: english
questions.unit_name: 用 Why don't you 提建议
questions.stem: 你觉得对方该先冷静，哪一句合适？
options: You should to calm down first.

questions.subject: english
questions.unit_name: 用 Why don't you 提建议
questions.stem: 想说压力太大，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: pressure 这里不可数，用 too much。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Dear Linda, I argued with my parents. I feel nervous. What should I do? 写信人怎么了？
options: 和父母吵了架，感到紧张

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Linda says: Why don't you talk to them? Although you are upset, they love you. Linda 建议什么？
questions.explain: Why don't you talk to them。

questions.subject: english
